summary: Configured a persistent Squid forward proxy on node1:3128 for node2. Only plain HTTP to node2:8081 is permitted; other destination ports and CONNECT tunnels return 403. The staged handbook origin was preserved and made persistent. Both nodes rebooted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot IDs.
actions_performed: Installed the AlmaLinux Squid 5.5 package on node1 without changing the OS release or kernel.
Configured Squid to accept node2 only, allow node2:8081 only, deny CONNECT, and deny all other requests.
Created and enabled a systemd service for the staged legacy origin on node2.
Added persistent, source-restricted firewalld rules for TCP/3128 and TCP/8081.
Verified allowed handbook retrieval and denied alternate-port and CONNECT requests.
Restarted node1 and node2 one at a time and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Proxy on node1 TCP/3128 serves the approved handbook to node2
evidence.summary: Squid configuration parsed successfully, listened on 3128, and returned the approved handbook through the proxy with HTTP 200.

evidence.requirement: Only node2:8081 is permitted; other ports and CONNECT tunnels are rejected
evidence.summary: Allowed requests returned the handbook; destination port 8080 and CONNECT to 8081 returned HTTP 403 before and after restarts. Squid logs directly record TCP_MISS/200 and TCP_DENIED/403 outcomes.

evidence.requirement: Staged origin is preserved and persistent
evidence.summary: The original file checksums remained unchanged, the service recovered active on 8081, and the handbook still contained “Approved branch handbook, revision 3.”

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel remain unchanged
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained AlmaLinux 9.6 with kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 after configuration and restart.
Healthy baseline boot ID d546da19-398f-473c-b85c-afdd17037523 was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 520aabc2-d355-42bc-8f50-7722af2fd351 observed, and Squid plus all policy tests recovered.

Healthy baseline boot ID e65e6bcf-e09d-42b7-8317-cb6310086cb7 was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 233e2695-c4d9-47e9-b9ff-ccce3c6a51eb observed, and the origin, staged files, handbook data, proxy path, and deny policy recovered.
